name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Endless horizontal or vertical loop of any content, with pause on hover and a still frame under reduced motion.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Run the loop in the opposite direction.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause while the pointer or keyboard focus is inside.

props.name: repeat
props.description: How many copies of the content to render. Raise it if the content is short.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items and between copies, any CSS length.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the loop and shows the content still.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
